title: Managing Violation Ticket Statuses in AEM

blocks.text: A status bucket is a high-level container that logically groups violation tickets with similar statuses, allowing you to track the progress and manage workflows efficiently. You can manage the status of violation tickets by creating status buckets.

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Violation Ticket Lifecycle.
The Violation Ticket Lifecycle page appears.
The Statuses page appears, displaying the default configuration for statuses and buckets.
From the Entity Type drop-down menu, select Violation Ticket.
Enter a name for the bucket.
(Optional) Select the following checkboxes to add a label to the status bucket:
Closed: Indicates that the violation ticket is closed.
Remediated: Indicates that the violation ticket is resolved.
These labels provide insights for metrics and calculations and allow you to view all closed violation tickets.
The new status bucket appears on the Violation Ticket Statuses page.

blocks.heading: Adding a Status to a Status Bucket

blocks.text: To add a status to a status bucket:

blocks.item: Click Add Status under the relevant status bucket.

blocks.heading: Editing, Rearranging, and Deleting Status Buckets

blocks.item: Hover over the bucket, and click the Edit icon.
Add or remove the labels (e.g., Closed).

blocks.text: To rearrange the order of buckets, hover over the bucket and use the Grid icon to drag it to the desired position.
To delete a bucket, hover over the bucket and click the Delete Bucket icon.
You can only delete the most recently added bucket.

blocks.heading: Editing, Rearranging, and Deleting Violation Ticket Statuses

blocks.text: You can only edit a status that is currently not used for a violation ticket.
To edit a violation ticket status:

blocks.item: Hover over the violation ticket status in the status bucket, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: To rearrange the order of violation ticket statuses in a status bucket, hover over the status and use the Grid icon to drag it to the desired position.
To delete a violation ticket status, hover over the status and click the Delete Status icon.
You can only delete the most recently added violation ticket status.

A status timeline is displayed on the top of each violation ticket, providing a visual cue of the violation ticket's current status. You can manually change the status of the violation ticket by selecting a new one from the drop-down menu.
